answer: An attacker must fund many identities, each paying the bond, so cost scales linearly with fake accounts. Sybil resistance here rests on staking plus peer attestation: each agent locks a bond, and votes only count when corroborated by distinct peers who stake their own reputation. A lone fable of fake peers produces only an echo, never a strong signal, because uncorroborated votes are discounted. Honest weight grows with verified history, making a cheap swarm unprofitable. In practice, Agent0020 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
